cases.name: peak-at-is-not-a-number
cases.description: peak_at is a row index, so a season name is not one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" period="12" peak_at="summer"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: peak-at-with-no-period
cases.description: a wave needs a length before it can have a highest point
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" peak_at="6"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: peak-at-beside-a-period-is-accepted
cases.description: the ordinary shape: nothing to say
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" period="12" peak_at="6"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: phase-is-not-the-attribute
cases.description: the word readers reach for; the engine spells it peak_at
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="timeseries" base="15" amplitude="10" period="12" phase="6"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: seasonal-lists-of-different-lengths
cases.description: period=, amplitude= and peak_at= describe the same waves position by position, so a length that disagrees describes no wave anybody can draw. It used to be half-read: the third amplitude was dropped and nothing said so.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="S"><gen type="timeseries" base="10" period="7,365" amplitude="1,2,3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-season-with-no-length-among-several
cases.description: period="0" on its own means "no seasonal wave", which is a sensible thing to write. Among several it is a wave nothing can be drawn from, standing beside waves that have a length.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="S"><gen type="timeseries" base="10" period="7,0" amplitude="1,2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: noise-correlation-at-one
cases.description: At 1 the noise stops being noise and becomes a random walk with no level to return to; above 1 it grows without bound. Refused rather than clamped, because a config asking for either meant something else.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="S"><gen type="timeseries" base="10" noise="1" noise_correlation="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: noise-correlation-with-nothing-to-correlate
cases.description: Correlation of WHAT: without noise= there is no jitter for one row to carry into the next, so the attribute decides nothing at all.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="S"><gen type="timeseries" base="10" noise_correlation="0.5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>
